# Product Pricing Guide

This guide summarizes the current subscription tiers for the platform.

## Basic Plan

The Basic plan costs $19 per month, billed monthly. It includes up to 5
user seats and 10GB of storage.

## Pro Plan

The Pro plan costs $49 per month, billed monthly, or $470 per year if
billed annually. It includes up to 25 user seats and 100GB of storage,
plus priority email support.

## Enterprise Plan

The Enterprise plan is priced by custom quote based on seat count and
storage needs. It includes unlimited user seats, unlimited storage, a
dedicated account manager, and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
